label: Singapore
short_description: Marriott Bonvoy hotels across Singapore, from Marina Bay towers to Orchard Road and Sentosa.
intro: Singapore's Bonvoy footprint spans the full portfolio, from flagship city hotels around Marina Bay and the Civic District to Orchard Road shopping-district properties and resort-style stays on Sentosa Island. As a compact, transit-connected city-state, the choice between neighborhoods usually comes down to proximity to Changi Airport, the Central Business District, or leisure attractions rather than raw distance.
